## Who may do what

For each action, the combinations `sekisho check` walked, put together where Cedar answers them alike and the same policies decide. Rows that differ in one column only are one row, the column holding their values: `any` is every value the column takes, `not …` every value but one. `-` is a column that does not apply to the row (the roles of a workflow, say).

### action `read_doc`

Read a document

- It guards no operation.
- Principals: `User`. Resources: `Doc`.
- 8 combinations, 2 of them allowed.

#### Allowed

| principal | staff | suspended | open_to_all | Deciding policies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| User | yes | no | any | staff_read_and_purge |

#### Denied

- `suspended_do_nothing` (`when principal.suspended`) applies to 4 combinations, and denies each; a permit applies to 2 of them too, and the forbid wins.
- `suspended_staff_see_nothing_open` (`principal in staff`, `when resource.open_to_all`, `when principal.suspended`) applies to 1 combination, and denies it; a permit applies to it too, and the forbid wins.
- No permit applies to the 2 other combinations that are denied.

<details>
<summary>The 4 rows that deny</summary>

| principal | staff | suspended | open_to_all | Deciding policies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| User | any | yes | no | suspended_do_nothing |
| User | no | yes | yes | suspended_do_nothing |
| User | yes | yes | yes | suspended_do_nothing, suspended_staff_see_nothing_open |
| User | no | no | any | no permit applies |

</details>

### action `purge_doc`

Remove a document for good

- It guards no operation.
- Principals: `User`. Resources: `Doc`.
- Allowed to no one: documents are kept.
- 8 combinations, none of them allowed.

#### Allowed

No combination is allowed.

#### Denied

- `suspended_do_nothing` (`when principal.suspended`) applies to 4 combinations, and denies each; a permit applies to 2 of them too, and the forbid wins.
- `no_one_purges` (every combination of the action) applies to 8 combinations, and denies each; a permit applies to 4 of them too, and the forbid wins.

|---|---|---|---|---|

## Policies

Each policy as the `.gate` writes it, beside the Cedar `sekisho gen --target cedar` generates for it. A permit allows the combinations it applies to; a forbid denies those it applies to, and wins where a permit applies too. Cedar denies a combination no policy applies to.

### permit `staff_read_and_purge`

Staff read documents, and would remove them

- On `read_doc`, it allows 2 combinations, and no other permit allows any of them.
- On `purge_doc`, it applies to 4 combinations, and a forbid denies each: it allows none.

`tests/doc/services.gate`

```gate
permit staff_read_and_purge
  description "Staff read documents, and would remove them"
  principal in staff
  action read_doc, purge_doc
```

`cedar/services.cedar`

```cedar
@id("services/staff_read_and_purge")
@doc("Staff read documents, and would remove them")
permit (
  principal in Library::Role::"staff",
  action in [Library::Action::"read_doc", Library::Action::"purge_doc"],
  resource is Library::Doc
);
```

### permit `services_index`

Services index the documents open to all

- On `index_doc`, it allows 1 combination, which no other permit allows.

`tests/doc/services.gate`

```gate
permit services_index
  description "Services index the documents open to all"
  principal is Service
  action index_doc
  when resource.open_to_all
```

`cedar/services.cedar`

```cedar
@id("services/services_index")
@doc("Services index the documents open to all")
permit (
  principal is Library::Service,
  action == Library::Action::"index_doc",
  resource is Library::Doc
)
when { resource.open_to_all };
```

### permit `staff_list`

Staff list a folder

- On `list_folder`, it allows 1 combination, which no other permit allows.

`tests/doc/services.gate`

```gate
permit staff_list

  principal in staff
  action list_folder
```

`cedar/services.cedar`

```cedar
@id("services/staff_list")
@doc("Staff list a folder")
permit (
  principal in Library::Role::"staff",
  action == Library::Action::"list_folder",
  resource is Library::Folder
);
```

### forbid `suspended_do_nothing`

A suspended person does nothing

- On `read_doc`, it applies to 4 combinations and denies them; a permit applies to 2 of them too.
- On `index_doc`, it applies to no combination: its line `when principal.suspended` is met on no combination of the action.
- On `purge_doc`, it applies to 4 combinations and denies them; a permit applies to 2 of them too.
- On `list_folder`, it applies to 2 combinations and denies them; a permit applies to 1 of them too.

`tests/doc/services.gate`

```gate
forbid suspended_do_nothing
  description "A suspended person does nothing"
  action any
  when principal.suspended
```

`cedar/services.cedar`

```cedar
@id("services/suspended_do_nothing")
@doc("A suspended person does nothing")
forbid (
  principal,
  action in
    [Library::Action::"read_doc",
     Library::Action::"index_doc",
     Library::Action::"purge_doc",
     Library::Action::"list_folder"],
  resource
)
when { principal has suspended && principal.suspended };
```

### forbid `services_skip_closed_docs`

A service leaves alone a document that is not open to all

- On `read_doc`, it applies to no combination: no principal of `read_doc` (`User`) meets its line `principal is Service`.
- On `index_doc`, it applies to 1 combination and denies it; no permit applies to it.
- On `purge_doc`, it applies to no combination: no principal of `purge_doc` (`User`) meets its line `principal is Service`.
- On `list_folder`, it applies to no combination: no principal of `list_folder` (`User`) meets its line `principal is Service`.

`tests/doc/services.gate`

```gate
forbid services_skip_closed_docs
  description "A service leaves alone a document that is not open to all"
  principal is Service
  action any
  unless resource.open_to_all
```

`cedar/services.cedar`

```cedar
@id("services/services_skip_closed_docs")
@doc("A service leaves alone a document that is not open to all")
forbid (
  principal is Library::Service,
  action in
    [Library::Action::"read_doc",
     Library::Action::"index_doc",
     Library::Action::"purge_doc",
     Library::Action::"list_folder"],
  resource
)
unless { resource has open_to_all && resource.open_to_all };
```

### forbid `no_one_purges`

Documents are kept

- On `purge_doc`, it applies to 8 combinations and denies them; a permit applies to 4 of them too.

`tests/doc/services.gate`

```gate
forbid no_one_purges
  description "Documents are kept"
  action purge_doc
```

`cedar/services.cedar`

```cedar
@id("services/no_one_purges")
@doc("Documents are kept")
forbid (
  principal,
  action == Library::Action::"purge_doc",
  resource is Library::Doc
);
```

### forbid `suspended_staff_see_nothing_open`

A suspended member of the staff sees nothing that is open to all

- On `read_doc`, it applies to 1 combination and denies it; a permit applies to it too.
- On `list_folder`, it applies to no combination: its `principal` line is met on 2 combinations, and its `when` and `unless` lines are never all met there.

`tests/doc/services.gate`

```gate
forbid suspended_staff_see_nothing_open
  description "A suspended member of the staff sees nothing that is open to all"
  principal in staff
  action read_doc, list_folder
  when resource.open_to_all
  when principal.suspended
```

`cedar/services.cedar`

```cedar
@id("services/suspended_staff_see_nothing_open")
@doc("A suspended member of the staff sees nothing that is open to all")
forbid (
  principal in Library::Role::"staff",
  action in [Library::Action::"read_doc", Library::Action::"list_folder"],
  resource
)
when { resource has open_to_all && resource.open_to_all }
when { principal.suspended };
```

## Roles

- `staff`: Anyone on the staff.

Whether a principal holding one role alone (and the roles it includes) is allowed each action: always, in every combination of the rest; sometimes, allowed in some combinations and denied in others; never, denied in every one. `-` is an action that does not take the principal's type. Where a role writes `can`, `sekisho check` holds the actions it is always or sometimes allowed to it.

| principal | `read_doc` | `index_doc` | `purge_doc` | `list_folder` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `User` holding `staff` | sometimes | - | never | sometimes |
| `Service` | - | sometimes | - | - |

## Operations guarded

No action guards an operation of a contract.
